subject: ela
intro: Pick the helpful visual or audio.

items.prompt:
Something the audience SEES in a presentation is a:
A) visual
B) audio
C) snack

Something the audience HEARS is:
A) a visual
B) audio
C) a chair

Presenting the parts of a plant, the BEST visual is:
A) a labeled diagram of a plant
B) a photo of a car
C) a menu
items.answer: A) a labeled diagram of a plant

steps: Matches the topic. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a labeled diagram of a plant

items.prompt:
For a presentation about animal sounds, what would help the audience most?
A) An audio recording of the sounds
B) A silent photo only
C) A blank page
items.answer: A) An audio recording of the sounds

steps: Audio lets them hear it. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) An audio recording of the sounds

items.prompt:
A GOOD visual for a presentation should:
A) match the topic and help the audience
B) be about something else
C) be too small to see
items.answer: A) match the topic and help the audience

steps: On topic and clear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) match the topic and help the audience

items.prompt:
To compare the sizes of three animals, the BEST visual is a:
A) chart or graph of their sizes
B) a poem
C) a joke
items.answer: A) chart or graph of their sizes

steps: Charts compare data. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) chart or graph of their sizes

items.prompt:
You present about the planets. Which set of visuals is BEST?
A) Pictures of each planet and a diagram of their order from the sun
B) A photo of your lunch
C) No visuals at all
items.answer: A) Pictures of each planet and a diagram of their order from the sun

steps: On topic and informative. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Pictures of each planet and a diagram of their order from the sun

items.prompt:
A visual is only helpful if the audience can:
A) clearly see it and it matches the topic
B) not see it
C) ignore it
items.answer: A) clearly see it and it matches the topic

steps: Visible and relevant. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) clearly see it and it matches the topic
